description: Short original reflections in a contemplative spirit. These are original writings by the app author - no copyrighted text is reproduced.

items.text: The mind that watches itself grows quiet on its own.

translations.en: The mind that watches itself grows quiet on its own.
translations.hi: जो मन स्वयं को देखता है, वह अपने आप शांत हो जाता है।

items.summary_2to3line: You do not have to force the mind to be still. Simply observe it without judgement, and its noise begins to settle by itself.
items.bodh_3to4line: Trying to stop thoughts is just more thinking. Sit back as a witness instead. Attention without interference is a gentle solvent - the agitation loosens when no one keeps stirring it.

items.text: You are not the weather of your mind; you are the sky it moves through.

translations.en: You are not the weather of your mind; you are the sky it moves through.
translations.hi: तुम मन का मौसम नहीं, वह आकाश हो जिससे वह गुज़रता है।

items.summary_1line: You are the sky, not the weather.
items.summary_2to3line: Thoughts and moods pass like clouds. The awareness that notices them is unchanging and untouched.
items.bodh_3to4line: Identify less with each passing mood. When anger or sadness arrives, remember it is a visitor in a space far larger than itself. You are the room, not the guest.

items.text: Comparison is a borrowed ruler; measure your growth with your own yesterdays.

translations.en: Comparison is a borrowed ruler; measure your growth with your own yesterdays.
translations.hi: तुलना उधार का पैमाना है; अपनी वृद्धि को अपने कल से नापो।

items.summary_1line: Measure yourself against your own past.
items.summary_2to3line: Measuring your life with someone else's scale always distorts. The honest comparison is with who you were yesterday.
items.bodh_3to4line: Envy and pride both come from borrowed standards. Drop the ruler and look only at your own direction: are you moving toward what you value? That question has no competitor.

items.text: Silence is not empty; it is where you meet yourself without an audience.

translations.en: Silence is not empty; it is where you meet yourself without an audience.
translations.hi: मौन खाली नहीं; वहीं तुम बिना दर्शक के स्वयं से मिलते हो।

items.summary_2to3line: Silence is not a lack of sound but a presence of attention. Without an audience, you can finally hear what is true in you.
items.bodh_3to4line: The world keeps you performing. Deliberate silence - a few minutes with nothing to do and no one to impress - restores the self that performance hides. Guard that time.

items.text: Let go not by throwing things away, but by holding them more lightly.

translations.en: Let go not by throwing things away, but by holding them more lightly.
translations.hi: छोड़ना चीज़ें फेंकना नहीं; उन्हें हल्के हाथों से थामना है।

items.summary_2to3line: Detachment is not renunciation. It is the same life held with looser hands, so nothing owns you.
items.bodh_3to4line: You do not have to leave the world to be free of it. Keep your work, your people, your joys - just hold them as gifts rather than possessions. A light grip keeps both the joy and the peace.
